title: DAY 4 — LESSON 6: GIVING FEEDBACK WITHOUT EMBARRASSING OTHERS

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of constructive feedback?
options: To embarrass someone so they never repeat a mistake
To help someone understand an issue and improve
To demonstrate who has more authority

questions.prompt: When should individual performance feedback usually be given?
options: Privately when practical, while addressing urgent safety issues immediately
In front of as many colleagues as possible

questions.prompt: Which statement focuses on behaviour rather than identity?
options: The room checklist was incomplete before the next appointment.

questions.prompt: What does the CARE method stand for?
options: Choose the setting, Address the issue, Respect the perspective, Explain improvement

questions.prompt: What should a supervisor do after discovering that a correction was based on inaccurate information?
options: Acknowledge the error, correct the information and apologise where appropriate
Continue blaming the employee to preserve authority
